description: Opens one GroundQuote contractor's interactive satellite map inside the chat. The homeowner finds their property, draws the fence line, picks material and height, and sees that contractor's price from measured footage; if they choose, they send their details or book a site visit right in the map (the same lead the contractor gets from their website: $5 browsing, $15 with a visit, billed to the contractor only on unlock). Prefer this over get_fence_estimate when the homeowner is able to draw. Use a contractor_id from the instant_quote group of find_fence_contractors. GroundQuote does not email or text the homeowner; the contractor contacts them.
name: open_quote_map
title: Let the homeowner draw their fence on a map
